title: Mirabel and the Verdict
author: August Ravensworth
blurb: Paloma Vasquez, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
